brand.tone: Clear, quick, unfussy. Written for someone deciding at 9pm whether to call tomorrow.
brand.photography: Bright, plain, the actual rooms and the actual staff.

proof.claim: The practice operates from two Columbus locations, Grandview and East.
Online scheduling is already live through the practice's patient portal.

concept.thesis: Most people should book the annual skin check.
concept.positioning: A four-clinician practice with real same-week capacity, and a website that hides it behind a menu. If you know what is wrong, this should take two taps; if you do not, the site should say what to book.
knownProblems: Scheduling already exists but is linked once, in the footer, as "Patient Portal".
Nineteen services are presented as one undifferentiated list, so a patient has to already know the name of their condition.
Four clinicians, and nothing on the site says who has the soonest opening or who sees children.
The Saturday morning clinic is not mentioned anywhere on the home page.
proposedImprovements: A booking action that is present on every screen, including a fixed bar on a phone.
Services grouped as "Start here" first, so somebody who does not know what to ask for still lands correctly.
A filter over the service list, because nineteen items is past the point where scanning works.
Each clinician carries what they actually cover and which office they sit in.
outOfScope: The booking button points at the practice's existing portal. Nothing here handles scheduling itself.
Wait times and openings are not shown; that needs a live feed from the practice management system.
No forms, and nothing that could receive health information.

findings.text: The practice publishes two locations and a Saturday morning clinic at Grandview.
A patient portal with online scheduling is already in use.
Four clinicians are listed: two physicians, one physician associate and one nurse practitioner.
The scheduling link is in the footer only, labelled "Patient Portal", and is easy to miss on a phone.
The services page is a single alphabetical list of nineteen items with no grouping and no search.
Nothing on the home page mentions Saturday hours.
Same-week capacity is the practice's strongest selling point and is currently invisible — needs confirming against their actual schedule before it goes in the hero.
Proposed hero line: “Most people should book the annual skin check. If something has changed, we hold this week open.”
